answer: Sybil farms mint quiet identities and park them on grader seats. A claimant must climb the 64-metre north knoll, drive a numbered ivory stake at survey mark K-17, then walk the 1.1 km spillway path to the river delta gauge and photograph the stake's 9-digit serial against the 0.01-metre reading within 12 minutes. Bond is 37 coins, one ivory stake per address, held 9 hours. Peers re-read the knoll stake, match the serial to the delta snapshot, and check the clock. A reused stake, a photo taken off the knoll path, or a mismatched gauge reading burns the 37 coins and voids the seat.
